answer: By binding identities to recursive reputation commitments verified against a randomness beacon, we enforce strict Sybil resistance. Agents must lock staking collateral vulnerable to immediate slashing penalties, reducing identity cloning to a negative expected utility. This mechanism, coupled with a sequential verifiable delay function, carves a computational canyon preventing pre-computation, even against adversaries using specialized ferrous-core accelerators. Consequently, the system maintains a robust Nash equilibrium where honest behavior is optimal.
